next.reason: X3.23a-1989 (its change for page XI-8, a typographical correction, errata C152) changed 'in the file' to 'in the files' in the second sentence; no requirement moved. §1985:XI.4.1.3 SR3: with variable length records for file-name-1, 'the size of the records contained in the files referenced by file-name-2 and file-name-3 must not be less than the smallest record nor greater than the largest record described for file-name-1'; with fixed length records it 'must not be greater than the largest record described for file-name-1'. §2023:14.9.24.3 SR3: 'the file description entry for file-name-2 or file-name-3 shall describe neither records smaller than the smallest record nor larger than the largest record described for file-name-1' and, for fixed-length records, 'shall not describe a record that is larger than the record described for file-name-1'. Both are syntax rules bounding the USING files' record sizes by file-name-1's smallest and largest described records; 'records contained in the files' and 'the file description entry ... shall describe' name the same compile-time fact. Same refusals.
